title: Use only explicit DeepGram attachments
description:
As a scoring runtime operator, I want timestamp enrichment to use only explicitly supplied DeepGram attachments, so that retired storage locations are not queried implicitly.

Feature: Explicit DeepGram attachment enrichment

Scenario: Metadata includes an explicit DeepGram attachment key
Given scoring metadata contains an attached DeepGram JSON key
When timestamp enrichment runs
Then it loads DeepGram from that key
And uses it for enrichment

Scenario: Metadata has no DeepGram payload or attachment key
Given scoring metadata has no DeepGram payload
And no attached DeepGram JSON key
When timestamp enrichment runs
Then it returns the original explanation
And no derived legacy object-store key is requested.
